label: 74HC194 4-bit Bidirectional Universal Shift Register

semantics.notes: 4-bit bidirectional shift register with mode select S1:S0. Modes: 00=Hold, 01=Shift-right (DSRâ†’Q0), 10=Shift-left (DSLâ†’Q3), 11=Parallel-load (D[3:0]â†’Q[3:0]). Async /CLR (active-low) resets all outputs to 0. DSR=serial data for right shift, DSL=serial data for left shift.

exportSupport.verilogNotes: always @(posedge clk or negedge clrn) with case statement on {s1,s0}.
exportSupport.vhdlNotes: process(clk, clrn) with case on s1 & s0.

testability.notes: Test all four modes: S1:S0=00 (hold stays unchanged); S1:S0=01 (shift-right: verify DSR enters Q0, previous Q0â†’Q1, Q1â†’Q2, Q2â†’Q3); S1:S0=10 (shift-left: verify DSL enters Q3, Q3â†’Q2, Q2â†’Q1, Q1â†’Q0); S1:S0=11 (parallel load all 16 combinations). Async /CLR: verify immediate reset regardless of mode. Test through all 16 shift-right steps to verify full 4-bit shift.

risks.description: No detailed description of shift-right vs shift-left bit ordering in project documentation.
No serial output pins. Real 74HC194 has serial outputs QA (=Q0) and QD (=Q3) for cascading. Cascading of shift registers requires using Q0/Q3 directly.

modelLimits: No explicit serial cascade output pin (use Q0 or Q3 for cascading).
